message: Implemented the S2 QK logits slice: added padded Q phase loading, slice-accumulated raw fp32 tile-0 logits export, and a cumulative S2 validator that rechecks the approved S0-S1 prefix before validating TMEM-style logits.
reflection: The missing frontier work was the tile-0 raw QK accumulator path and its independent oracle. I added a staged host-side qk_mainloop with explicit 64x16 padded Q slices, a separate eager reference for the live 16x32 logits, S2 debug export plumbing, and temporary S2 CuTe shell printf instrumentation while preserving the approved S0-S1 structure. The smallest next fix is S3’s base-2 softmax/correction pipeline; regression risk to approved prefixes is low because the S2 validator re-runs the S1 validator on cloned inputs and the cumulative frontier passed 5/5 synthetic cases.
